description: This file contains test functions for the 'operator' package, testing various functionalities of polled set connections including creation, retrieval, messaging, and destruction.

methods.name: TestNewPolledConnection
methods.description: Tests creation of new polled connections and checks for unique IDs.

methods.name: TestGetConnection
methods.description: Tests retrieval of connections by ID from the polled set.

methods.name: TestMessages
methods.description: Tests message sending and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: TestDestroy
methods.description: Tests proper destruction of a connection upon device disconnection.

methods.name: TestRandStr
methods.description: Tests the randomness and length of generated strings.
